user.title: Pair the isolated OAuth trial
user.description: Experimental official Spotify public-client test, read-only user-read-private. The App owns provider grants and excludes its private keys from backups. Core stores a private pairing key on the trusted HA host; encrypted Core backups are required. Missing keys lock the trial. The original twenty-minute window never restarts. Paste the private bootstrap block from the distinct trial App. Never enter a Client Secret, token or another integration's credentials.

data.encrypted_core_backups: I accept the trusted-host model and use encrypted Core backups

data_description.app_slug: Use local_symphonia_native_oauth_trial or the exact eight-hex repository prefix. No URL or port.
data_description.client_id: Public opaque identifier only; no Client Secret.
data_description.bootstrap: One-use challenge and server pin, valid five minutes. Keep it private.

connect.title: Start read-only Spotify consent
connect.description: Only {scope}, using the official public PKCE client through Core and My. No playback, writes or existing Spotify credentials. The return will only be staged; a new same-admin confirmation is still required. Original deadline: {deadline} UTC epoch. The external grant can outlive this trial and must be revoked separately.

confirm.title: Confirm the staged Spotify return
confirm.description: The callback was received and staged. No code has been exchanged. Confirm now as the same active administrator to admit one App-only exchange and account check. Original deadline: {deadline}. Do not repeat an uncertain operation.

refresh.title: Verify the persisted App grant
refresh.description: Restart only the trial App first. Confirm one forced refresh using the same encrypted grant, then compare the account. Scope remains {scope}; no new consent or Core token storage is used. Original deadline: {deadline}.

data.confirm: Run the one refresh and account check

reconfigure.title: Choose the trial operation
reconfigure.description: Choose connect, refresh or retire from the available states. Retirement requires another confirmation and does not revoke the external Spotify grant. Original deadline: {deadline}.

retire.title: Retire the isolated trial
retire.description: Revoke the private pair, remove the local sealed grant and clean only hash-matching Core keys. Then remove this integration, stop/remove the App and separately revoke dedicated Spotify access. Modified or unknown files are preserved. If retirement is unconfirmed, stop the App; grant deletion is not claimed.

error.administrator_required: Use the active administrator who started the trial. No provider operation was admitted.
error.trial_unavailable: The trial is unavailable. Retire it; never repeat an uncertain exchange or refresh.

abort.administrator_required: Use the active administrator who paired and started this trial.
abort.pairing_failed_retire_trial: Pairing was not confirmed. No provider consent was started. Retire the isolated trial; follow the owned-key cleanup guide before trying a fresh installation.
abort.consent_denied: Spotify consent was denied. No grant is active. Retire this trial before a fresh installation.
abort.oauth_active: The App verified the account and sealed the grant. Restart only the trial App, then use Reconfigure to confirm its one refresh before the original deadline.
abort.trial_verified: Native OAuth, App restart and refresh account match are verified. Remove this integration, stop/remove the trial App and revoke the dedicated Spotify access separately.
abort.trial_unavailable: The trial cannot continue safely; its result may be uncertain or expired. Do not repeat a code or refresh. Retire the isolated trial and record the observed outcome.
abort.already_configured: This installation is already paired. Reconfigure the existing trial entry.
abort.trial_retired: Local pair and grant retired; Core keys cleaned. Remove this integration and trial App, then revoke dedicated Spotify access separately.
abort.retirement_key_cleanup_pending: App retirement is confirmed. Modified or unknown Core key files remain; follow the cleanup guide without forcing removal.
abort.retirement_unconfirmed: Retirement is unconfirmed. Stop and remove the trial App; grant deletion and external revocation are not claimed. Keys remain for verified cleanup.
abort.unsupported_core: This trial supports only Core 2026.10.4 on aarch64. Do not downgrade Home Assistant; revalidate the trial before installation.
